manifest.name: compare_countries_by_world_bank_indicator
manifest.description: Fetches the latest World Bank indicator value (default population) for a list of countries and ranks them.
manifest.purpose: make a bot to compare countries populations
manifest.headline: Among the countries compared, {largest.country_name} ranks first with {largest.value} ({largest.year}), while {smallest.country_name} ranks last with {smallest.value}, making the largest about {ratio} times the smallest.
examples: Which is bigger by population, India or China?
Compare the populations of the US, Brazil and Japan
Rank Germany, France, Italy and Spain by number of people
manifest.manual_basis: Fetch population data from World Bank API for 4 countries, organize in spreadsheet, sort by value, format comparison table.
